title: Landora Tours
subtitle: A Sri Lankan tour operator built from a blank page
cardSummary: The client had packages and hotels — nothing else. We researched the market, designed it, built it and tested it: 106 pages, a clickable island map, and a planner that lets travellers build their own trip.
summary: Landora Tours arrived with a list of packages and the hotels they work with. Everything else — what the site should be, how it should be organised, how it should look and how it should behave — was ours. We researched the market, designed the experience, built it in Next.js and tested it: 106 pages, an interactive island map, and a step-by-step planner that lets a traveller assemble their own journey.
role: Research, UI/UX design, engineering and QA
timeline: Two weeks, blank page to review

cover.alt: The Landora Tours homepage showing an itinerary and the interactive island map

title: Susila
subtitle: Rebuilding the streaming layer of a Sinhala film platform
cardSummary: A film streaming platform that looked finished but could not take a payment, check who had paid, or stream reliably. We rebuilt delivery, billing and access control, then added live streaming.
summary: Susila Productions had a subscription streaming platform that had already been built. The pricing page took no money, nothing on the server checked who was entitled to watch, and playback ran through a third-party embed that could not adapt to a mobile connection. We rebuilt video delivery, subscription billing and access control, restructured the front end, and later added live broadcast.
role: Engineering, UI/UX and QA across the rebuild
timeline: About one month, handover to launch

cover.alt: The Susila streaming platform playing a film in the custom HLS player

title: LevelUp Saloon
subtitle: Rebuilding an AI-generated salon platform that only looked finished
cardSummary: An AI-built salon app that ran fine and silently discarded every appointment edit. We rebuilt it underneath in five phases, audited all four flows end to end, and changed nothing the staff could see.
cardMeta: Rebuild and audit · shipped on time
summary: LevelUp Saloon had a working salon management app — built with AI assistance, running, demoable. It also had a core flow that failed silently: every edit to a scheduled appointment was rejected by the database and rolled back, while the interface reported success. We rebuilt the system underneath across five phases without touching a single line of their design, then audited all four flows end to end and fixed what that turned up.
role: Rebuild and end-to-end audit — engineering and QA
timeline: Five phases, then a full audit, against a fixed date

cover.alt: The LevelUp Saloon dashboard showing the appointment calendar
